mintAuthority.summary: PHT's Ethereum deployment mints through a Maker-style DaiJoin and Vat path. Polygon uses an owner-controlled UUPS LayerZero OFT, while Tron uses an unverified, non-proxy PhtOFT whose owner can set peers and the LayerZero delegate. Fixed-block deployment supplies put Tron at 15.8053% of the summed observed supply on 2026-07-14. The Polygon and Tron control identities are now sourced, but the Tron peer, endpoint, and cross-chain mint semantics and the Ethereum Vat ward set remain unresolved, so the posture stays unbounded-or-compromised.

controls.label: APACX PHT vault/CDP mint path
controls.capDescription: PHT mints through the Maker-style Vat CDP engine. At 2026-07-20 the Vat reads Line()=250,000,000 rad (global debt ceiling) and ilk USDT-A line=500,000,000 rad; the ward mapping is not enumerable, so the ability to change those ceilings remains unresolved.
controls.evidence: At 2026-07-20 (Ethereum): Vat 0xEE0CDe42Bb6841736d809d2Bb63EbF59dB6E336c live=1; Line()=250,000,000 rad; ilks(USDT-A).line=500,000,000 rad, Art=6,939. rely() simulations and wards() reads for the identified deployment-related addresses returned not-authorized/zero, but wards is a non-enumerable mapping, so those probes cannot establish that no other live ward can change the ceilings.

controls.label: DaiJoin adapter (sole warded minter on PHT ETH)
controls.capDescription: DaiJoin.exit() mints PHT permissionlessly when a user withdraws collateral-backed credit from the Vat; supply is bounded by the Vat's per-ilk debt ceilings set by Vat wards.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295271: PHT token (dai.sol fork, AGPL-3.0) wards(DaiJoin 0x4bd328FD071b03e157d0a89dE199d9E005D71057)=1 (warded). All other checked addresses returned 0: deployer 0x813da81, Vat 0xEE0CDe42, vault contracts 0x59A904af/0x881bA6, EOA 0x76dB01fC. DaiJoin.exit() calls dai.mint(usr, wad) permissionlessly based on Vat internal state. Vat (0xEE0CDe42Bb6841736d809d2Bb63EbF59dB6E336c, live=1) is the CDP engine. DaiJoin.dai()=0xBe370Ad (confirmed PHT token).

controls.label: Vat CDP engine admin (debt ceiling / risk param control)
controls.evidence: At 2026-07-20, rely() on the Vat reverted with 'Vat/not-authorized' from the identified deployment-related addresses and wards() reads returned zero for each. Because wards is a non-enumerable mapping, these probes do not resolve an unknown ward that could change debt ceilings or risk parameters.

controls.label: Polygon PHT OFT owner
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90223288, the PHT proxy's EIP-1967 implementation was 0x98210a4b...0618 and its canonical admin slot was zero. The implementation returned the ERC-1967 UUID and contains upgradeToAndCall, confirming UUPS. owner() returned this EOA, which can administer the OFT and authorize upgrades without a resolved timelock or multisig.

controls.label: Tron PHT OFT owner

sources.label: Tronscan API - Tron PHT contract metadata

controls.evidence: Tronscan identifies TXdN5...mmrs as an unverified, non-proxy PhtOFT and exposes owner-only setPeer and setDelegate selectors. At Tron block 84456628, owner() returned hex 0xfb99a0af49941ec1ca2fc726be1e287f4c70f5ee, the base58 EOA recorded here. Current peer, endpoint, and mint/burn route semantics were not independently resolved, so the owner's exact durable-supply authority remains unknown.

sources.label: Tronscan API - Tron PHT contract metadata

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25531532 totalSupply was 225,011,899.761301444119160709 PHT through the reviewed Maker-style DaiJoin/Vat deployment. Polygon block 90223288 totalSupply was 11,984,287.03 PHT; that deployment is an owner-controlled UUPS LayerZero OFT. Tron block 84456628 totalSupply was 44,489,605.678905 PHT; Tronscan identifies it as an unverified, non-proxy PhtOFT with an EOA owner able to set peers and the endpoint delegate. Across the summed deployment supplies of 281,485,792.470206444119160709 PHT, Tron represented 15.80527574%, not the stale 19.8% in the curation report. This is an observed deployment-supply materiality basis, not a canonical-circulating reconciliation. The Ethereum Vat ward set and the Tron peer/endpoint/mint route remain unresolved. Probes of known deployment-related addresses did not identify a Vat ward, but the non-enumerable wards mapping prevents proving the global and ilk ceilings immutable. The DaiJoin ward on the PHT token is 0x4bd328FD071b03e157d0a89dE199d9E005D71057 (wards=1). The Tron OFT owner is verified as TYuYeSqxFF5CjtpFjv46nWWeiAWjVe2iY4, and the Polygon/Tron PHT deployments are issuer-operated LayerZero OFTs using burn-mint (Polygon endpoint verified as LayerZero EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c). Re-reviewed 2026-07-27 (Kimi data review): APACX has published no new admin-control inventory since the 2026-07-20 fixed-block reads, so the review is complete to the extent public sources allow and is marked scoreable with confidence capped at manual-review. Two structural unknowns remain recorded rather than resolved: (1) the current Tron PhtOFT peer, endpoint, receive/mint semantics, and owner-controlled configuration path on the unverified Tron deployment (15.80527574% of the observed summed deployment supply in the reviewed snapshot); (2) the Ethereum Vat ward set, which is a non-enumerable mapping, so the observed global and ilk debt ceilings cannot be proven immutable — economicCapSemantics is therefore recorded as raiseable, the conservative reading between the reviewed numeric ceilings and the unprovable ward history. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the Polygon EOA can upgrade the OFT without a delay, while the Tron route and whole-supply collateral reconciliation remain unresolved and no supervisor or attestor is evidenced.
